notes.title: DROD: The Original Trilogy is released as DLC!
notes.content:
You can now pick up a copy of the original DROD trilogy as DLC for "Gunthro":

[list]
[*]King Dugan's Dungeon
[*]Journey to Rooted Hold
[*]The City Beneath
[/list]

The titles are available either separately or [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1847/]as a bundle[/url].

Each title has its own set of achievements and has been upgraded to make use of features in the new version 5.0 game engine.

The best things come to those who wait.  Thanks for your patience while we worked to make these releases shine!
